crossRefs.note: Don’t let the foot of pride come against me. Don’t let the hand of the wicked drive me away.
For strangers have risen up against me. Violent men have sought after my soul. They haven’t set God before them.
The arrogant mock me excessively, but I don’t swerve from your law.
The proud have smeared a lie upon me. With my whole heart, I will keep your precepts.
The proud have dug pits for me, contrary to your law.
The proud have hidden a snare for me, they have spread the cords of a net by the path. They have set traps for me.
After this, Absalom prepared a chariot and horses for himself, and fifty men to run before him.
Then Absalom said to Ahithophel, “Give your counsel what we shall do.”
Moreover Ahithophel said to Absalom, “Let me now choose twelve thousand men, and I will arise and pursue after David…
Absalom and all the men of Israel said, “The counsel of Hushai the Archite is better than the counsel of Ahithophel.”…
Then the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders of the people were gathered together in the court of the high…
They took counsel together that they might take Jesus by deceit, and kill him.
Now when morning had come, all the chief priests and the elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to…
and they bound him, and led him away, and delivered him up to Pontius Pilate, the governor.
“For truly, both Herod and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles and the people of Israel, were gathered together against…
to do whatever your hand and your council foreordained to happen.
The wicked, in the pride of his face, has no room in his thoughts for God.
He says in his heart, “God has forgotten. He hides his face. He will never see it.”
Why does the wicked person condemn God, and say in his heart, “God won’t call me into account?”
Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don’t call on Yahweh?
A revelation is within my heart about the disobedience of the wicked: “There is no fear of God before his eyes.”
Then he said to me, “Son of man, have you seen what the elders of the house of Israel do in the dark, every man in his…
Then he said to me, “The iniquity of the house of Israel and Judah is exceedingly great, and the land is full of blood…

translations.web: God, the proud have risen up against me. A company of violent men have sought after my soul, and they don’t hold regard for you before them.
translations.bsb: The arrogant rise against me, O God; a band of ruthless men seeks my life; they have no regard for You.

translations.asv: O God, the proud are risen up against me, And a company of violent men have sought after my soul, And have not set thee before them.
